toml:
node_name = "laptop"

[harness]
id = "claude"
version = "2.5.0"

[session]
budget_tokens = 2000000
default_channel = "personal"

[review]
max_diff_lines = 4000
max_files = 120

[publish]
gh = "/usr/bin/gh"

[github.dispatch]
"op/homelab" = ["renovate.yaml"]

[mesh]
hub_url = "https://hub.example.net"

[notify]
contact = "mailto:op@example.com"

[[service]]
name = "browser"
image = "ghcr.io/op/chromium@sha256:5b0e8a1c9d2f4e6a8b0c2d4e6f8a0b2c4d6e8f0a2b4c6d8e0f2a4b6c8d0e2f4a"
